subject: The secret I set aside for 30-day users expires tomorrow
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this, but you've been here a month. This changes how you see everything. Don't miss it.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. When I built this app, I made one feature too powerful. So powerful, I was scared to give it to everyone right away. I've seen what it does—it doesn't just scan texts, it breaks cycles.

For the first 30 days, I hold it back. I set it aside. It's for people who stick around, who prove they're serious about protecting their peace. You hit day 29. Tomorrow, the gate closes. This isn't a discount. It's the master key: lifetime access to the Pattern Lock feature. It's the one that connects dots across months of conversations, showing you the toxic blueprint you've been missing.

Open the app. Tap the 'Upgrade' tab. You'll see it: '30-Day User Vault.' Inside is the Pattern Lock, plus the Toxicity Score Breakdown and the Relationship Health Dashboard—for life. No monthly fee. Just the clarity your gut has been begging for.

This vault deletes itself in 24 hours. Tap the button below. Open the app and claim it before midnight tomorrow. P.S. The 800+ users who have this? They message me saying one thing: 'I wish I saw this sooner.' Don't let that be you.
cta_text: Open Red Flag Scanner AI & Claim Your Vault
